checked_classes: Spec violations — acceptance criteria for provenance, plugin-only Anthropic skills, third-party notices, project-authored skills, payer citation rule, harness mirrors, and research record are addressed by the diff/evidence packet.
Correctness — mirror script logic checks listed project and third-party skills, validates source SKILL.md presence, compares file lists and bytes, and exits nonzero on drift in --check mode.
Regressions — no existing files are modified in a way the packet shows as removing prior behavior; added settings/docs/scripts/skills are consistent with the stated target.
Security — unlicensed Anthropic skills are plugin-enabled rather than vendored, PHI lane policy defaults to synthetic data, and the packet records clean scans/no introduced credentialed DSNs.
Constraint breaches — no Go, schema, store, handler, helm, or generated-file paths are touched; packet evidence marks Go build/test/lint constraints N/A and no-hardcoded-secrets baseline-only.
Silent failure — mirror check reports missing sources and drift with nonzero exits; payer skill requires unverified source gaps to be stated rather than silently relying on memory.
